description:
DataFusion DataFrame mode regressed after dependency updates: the CLI now
fails to load TPC-H .tbl files (DataFusion enforces .csv extension), does not
generate or convert data in the adapter execution path, and continues running
queries after load failures. The fix must target the actual adapter path
(benchbox/platforms/dataframe/benchmark_mixin.py) and ensure robust behavior
across DataFusion versions.

Scope includes:
- Add explicit .tbl support in the DataFusion adapter (version-aware handling).
- Route DataFrame adapter loads through data preparation/conversion when
  prefer_parquet is enabled.
- Validate data availability before load; fail early with actionable guidance.
- Fail fast on load errors to prevent query execution with empty tables.
- Add tests that exercise the adapter path (not only dataframe_runner).
